title: They Testified Against SBF. Here's What Happened to Them

lines.say: Sam Bankman-Fried's trial turned on three former insiders: Caroline Ellison, Gary Wang, and Nishad Singh. All three had pleaded guilty.

scene.src: Washington Post via Spokesman-Review · Straight Arrow News

lines.say: Ellison testified she told him, we don't really have the money for this, we'll have to borrow from FTX to do it.

scene.q: We don't really have the money for this, we'll have to borrow from FTX to do it.
scene.cite: As quoted in the gov't sentencing memorandum

lines.say: Singh testified about a talk on a penthouse balcony, where Bankman-Fried acknowledged they were a little short on deliverable.
The jury convicted Bankman-Fried on all seven counts. He got twenty-five years.
lines.show: The jury convicted Bankman-Fried on all 7 counts. He got 25 years.

lines.say: Ellison was sentenced to two years. Singh and Wang avoided prison. Another FTX executive, Ryan Salame, got seven and a half years.
lines.show: Ellison was sentenced to two years. Singh and Wang avoided prison. Another FTX executive, Ryan Salame, got 7½ years.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
